findings.description: Before this change, `Bundle.missing` listed keys with no translation in the requested locale. Now a key found only in a parent or the default locale is recorded in `sources` and not in `missing`. `missing_report` is built from `missing`, so for a pt-BR request that falls back to English, translators no longer see those keys in the report. Callers that relied on `missing` to flag untranslated keys will silently stop receiving them.
findings.suggestion: Keep `missing` as keys not found in the requested locale, for example by appending to it when the matched candidate is not chain[0], and let `fallback_keys` cover the fallback case. Alternatively, rename the field and update `missing_report` to match the intended meaning.
findings.title: `missing` now means absent in every locale, not just the requested one

findings.description: `fallback_chain` calls `normalise`, which raises `ValueError` for an empty or whitespace-only tag. Before this change, `build_bundle` accepted any locale string. If a request arrives without a locale, for example an empty Accept-Language value, this call now raises on the page path rather than falling back to the default locale.
findings.suggestion: Catch the empty-tag case in `build_bundle` and substitute `default_locale`, or validate the locale at the request boundary so the error is handled there.
findings.title: Empty or blank locale now raises ValueError instead of rendering
